zh.title: 西南航空開闢六條往夏威夷新不經停航線
zh.summary: 西南航空今日新增六條夏威夷不經停航線；大部分自加州出發
body: 西南航空（Southwest Airlines）宣布新增六條直飛夏威夷的航線，這項消息由航空新聞網站Simple Flying於2026年9月20日報導，報導標題為「Southwest Airlines Starts 6 Major New Nonstop Routes To Hawaii: See Flights Now」，內文摘要指出「All but one originate in California」，意味著六條新航線中有五條從加州出發。
六條新航線均屬不經停服務，除一條外其餘五條皆以加州機場為起飛點。

en.title: Southwest Airlines launches six new nonstop routes to Hawaii
en.summary: Southwest Airlines adds six nonstop Hawaii routes; five originate from California
body: Southwest Airlines has launched six new nonstop routes to Hawaii, according to a report from aviation news site Simple Flying published on 20 September 2026. The article’s headline reads “Southwest Airlines Starts 6 Major New Nonstop Routes To Hawaii: See Flights Now,” and its summary states “All but one originate in California,” indicating that five of the six routes depart from California airports.

All six routes are nonstop services, with the majority originating in California. The report comes from Simple Flying. The article was published on 20 September 2026. The summary notes that all but one originate in California.

zh.title: EASA年度安全報告：2025年航空事故116人死亡
zh.summary: EASA與Eurostat發布年度安全報告；2025年共116人死於航空事故，多數屬非商業飛行
body: 歐洲航空安全局（EASA）與歐盟統計局（Eurostat）發布2025年年度安全報告，統計發生在歐盟境內或涉及歐盟註冊航空器的事故死亡與受傷人數。
報告顯示，2025年共有116人因航空事故死亡，其中79人死於固定翼動力飛機事故；直升機與滑翔機各造成18人死亡，另有1人死於熱氣球事故。此數字高於2024年通報的91人死亡。
在116名死者中，109人涉及私人非商業航班，包括一般航空與商務航空。規模最大的單一事故是2025年12月發生在土耳其安卡拉附近的墜機，一架馬爾他註冊的Falcon 50噴射機搭載利比亞官方代表團，造成8人死亡，其中包括利比亞陸軍首長。
在歐盟境內或空域的非商業航空事故中，死亡人數最多的國家為法國（28人）、德國（12人），羅馬尼亞與斯洛伐克各有6人死亡。
2025年商業航空營運僅有4人死亡，2024年為3人，2023年則為零。另有3人在包括農藥噴灑、檢查飛行與空拍等專業空中作業中遇難。
報告警告，整體而言這些數字相對較低，但單一重大事故可能大幅影響統計。2015年是近年商業作業在歐盟航空死亡人數中占多數的一年，原因為「德國之翼」9525班機在法國阿爾卑斯山區的人為墜毀事故。
2025年航空作業中受傷人數為143人，低於2024年的215人。其中93人屬飛機作業，熱氣球與滑翔機分別有19人與17人受傷，直升機作業有12人受傷，另有2例為無人機系統作業受傷。

en.title: EASA safety review: 116 aviation deaths across Europe-linked flights in 2025
en.summary: EASA/Eurostat annual review reports 116 deaths in 2025; most in non-commercial flying
body: The European Aviation Safety Agency (EASA) and Eurostat, the European Union's statistical agency, have published the 2025 Annual Safety Review, covering accidents in EU territory or involving EU-registered aircraft.

The report says 116 people died in 2025 because of aviation accidents, including 79 in fixed-wing powered aircraft accidents. Helicopters and sailplanes accounted for 18 deaths each, and one death was recorded in a balloon accident.
This is higher than the 91 deaths reported in 2024. Of the 116 victims, 109 were in private non-commercial flights, including general and executive aviation.

The largest single incident of this type in 2025 involving an EU-linked aircraft was the December 2025 crash of a Malta-registered Falcon 50 jet near Ankara, Turkey, carrying an official Libyan delegation; eight people died, including the head of the Libyan army.
Among non-commercial accidents inside EU territory or airspace, France had the most deaths with 28, followed by Germany with 12, and Romania and Slovakia with six each.

Four people died in commercial operations in 2025, versus three in 2024 and none in 2023. Three more were killed in specialised aerial work such as crop-spraying, inspection flights and aerial photography.

The report warns that while figures remain relatively low, a single major accident can markedly change the picture. It says 2015 was the most recent year where commercial operations caused most EU-related deaths, due to the Eurowings flight 9525 crash in the French Alps. The number of people injured in 2025 was 143, down from 215 in 2024; 93 of those were in fixed-wing operations, with balloons and sailplanes at 19 and 17 respectively, helicopters 12, and two injuries in unmanned aircraft operations.
